name: webperf-core-web-vitals
works_with: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, VS Code extensions and other Agent Skills agents, with Chrome DevTools MCP
short: Measures a page's LCP, CLS and INP with tested scripts and walks your agent through debugging whichever one is slow.
what: One of the WebPerf Snippets skills. Your agent runs seven fixed, CI-tested JavaScript snippets in your browser through Chrome DevTools MCP and reads the structured result each returns. It has workflows for a full Core Web Vitals audit, an LCP deep dive, CLS and INP debugging, and video as LCP. Decision trees pick the next snippet from the last result.
who: Front-end developers chasing a slow LCP, layout shifts or sluggish interactions. You need Chrome DevTools MCP, or the CLI as a fallback. If you only want a score, the CLI alone is simpler.
needs: A coding agent that supports skills
Chrome DevTools MCP 1.11.0 or later, to run scripts by path
Without it: the webperf-snippets CLI with Playwright and Chromium

steps.title: Install the skills
steps.text: This installs all the WebPerf skills into `~/.claude/skills/`.

steps.title: Or install from a clone
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/nucliweb/webperf-snippets.git
cd webperf-snippets
npm run install-skills   # into .claude/skills/ of the current project
npm run install-global   # into ~/.claude/skills/, for every project

steps.title: Let Chrome DevTools MCP read the scripts
steps.text: For skills outside your project, add `--workspace` with the real folder of the skills, not a symlink. Without it the skills still work after one failed call per session.

steps.title: Without Chrome DevTools MCP
steps.text: Run the same snippets with the CLI.
steps.code:
npm install --save-dev webperf-snippets playwright
npx playwright install chromium
npx webperf-snippets <url> --snippet <Name> --json

try.label: From the README
try.text: "Audit this page for Core Web Vitals" or "Debug slow LCP"

watch: With Chrome DevTools MCP your agent drives your Chrome, including pages you are logged in to.
This copy of the skill is the Antigravity build, and its settings name a Gemini model. `npx skills add` installs from the same repo.
Several follow-up scripts in the CLS and INP workflows live in the webperf-interaction skill and are marked pending here.
